gaps.title: Revisable AI Notarial Extraction
gaps.pain: Notaries fear AI errors that can have legal consequences; they spend excessive time manually verifying AI output, negating efficiency gains.
gaps.why_now: AI/NLP advanced enough for high-accuracy extraction, but trust remains a barrier; no competitor offers an explainable, reviewable AI layer tailored to notarial acts.
gaps.evidence_needed: Build prototype with highlighted extracted fields, confidence scores, and an editing interface; conduct user tests with 5 notaries, measure verification time reduction and trust scores.
gaps.risk: Direct competitor LexNotari could add explainability features quickly; regulatory uncertainty about AI usage in legally binding documents.

gaps.title: Plug-and-Play Government e-Filing Integration
gaps.pain: Manual submission to multiple registries causes errors, delays, and compliance risks.
gaps.why_now: Government digitization initiatives are releasing APIs; notaries need a single integration hub to cut processing time.
gaps.evidence_needed: Integrate with one country’s land registry API, pilot with 3 notaries, record time savings and error reduction.
gaps.risk: Government APIs may be unstable or require lengthy certification; long sales cycles to gain official approval.

gaps.title: AI-Powered Mobile Document Scanner for Notaries
gaps.pain: Mobile notaries need to process and validate documents on the go; existing apps lack AI extraction and validation.
gaps.why_now: Smartphone cameras and on-device AI models can now perform accurate OCR and field verification offline.
gaps.evidence_needed: Create a mobile MVP with OCR and instant field validation; test with 10 traveling notaries for usability and accuracy.
gaps.risk: LexNotari or QuickNotary could add mobile features; hardware limitations may affect scanning quality in poor lighting.

gaps.title: Collaborative Drafting Platform with Lawyer/Client Portal
gaps.pain: Back-and-forth drafts via email cause version control chaos and delays in notarial document preparation.
gaps.why_now: Remote work surge has increased demand for secure, real-time co-editing in legal workflows.
gaps.evidence_needed: Design wireframes and a clickable prototype; interview 5 notaries handling complex documents about collaboration pain points.
gaps.risk: NotariaCloud may launch collaborative features; driving adoption requires change management in traditional offices.

gaps.title: Offline-First Notarial App with Selective Sync
gaps.pain: Frequent internet outages in rural LATAM disrupt notarial work, forcing fallback to paper or delayed processing.
gaps.why_now: Modern web frameworks (CRDTs, IndexedDB) make robust offline-first apps feasible without high cost.
gaps.evidence_needed: Develop an offline-capable MVP with document editing and queuing; survey 5 rural notaries on current outage impacts and willingness to adopt.
gaps.risk: Data sync conflicts could arise; the addressable market of rural notaries may be too small for rapid growth.

gaps.title: Voice-to-Document AI for Notarial Interviews
gaps.pain: Notaries spend significant time manually typing dictations from client interviews, leading to errors and fatigue.
gaps.why_now: Speech recognition accuracy (e.g., Whisper) is now viable for specialized legal vocabulary and can be fine-tuned.
gaps.evidence_needed: Prototype voice-to-structured-document pipeline; test with 3 notaries during live interviews, measure drafting time reduction.
gaps.risk: Legal jargon may still cause transcription errors; privacy concerns with audio recording may deter adoption.

checkpoint_instruction: Validate top gap by conducting 10 in-depth interviews with notaries and creating a clickable prototype that demonstrates explainable AI extraction; measure verification time and trust level compared to their current tools.
